properties.name: MEASURED 2026-09-16: IfcMCP installs from PyPI as `ifcopenshell-mcp` 0.8.5 (not `ifcmcp`, which the docs name and which does not exist), serves 25 tools headless over stdio in under a second, and its `[mcp]` extra pulls mcp 2.x which it cannot run on — pin `mcp>=1,<2`
properties.statement: On Anthony's pointer to docs.ifcopenshell.org/ifcmcp.html, installed on his dev box: `uv tool install --with pyvista --with 'mcp>=1,<2' 'ifcopenshell-mcp[mcp]'`. Three traps recorded because each cost a round trip: (1) the docs say `pip install ifcmcp`; PyPI has no such package — the project name in pyproject is `ifcopenshell-mcp`, and the source lives at IfcOpenShell/src/ifcmcp; (2) the `[mcp]` extra resolved to mcp 2.2.0 and the server refused to start ("the 'mcp' package is required"), because it imports mcp.server.fastmcp, renamed in 2.0 — pyproject pins <2 but the extra did not hold under uv tool install; (3) `ifc_render` needs pyvista and the geometry bindings, which installed cleanly (pyvista 0.49, vtk 9.7). Probe over stdio: initialize, tools/list → 25 tools: ifc_new, ifc_load, ifc_save, ifc_reset, ifc_summary, ifc_tree, ifc_info, ifc_select, ifc_relations, ifc_clash, ifc_contexts, ifc_materials, ifc_list, ifc_docs, ifc_edit, ifc_validate, ifc_schedule, ifc_cost, ifc_schema, ifc_quantify, ifc_shape_list, ifc_shape_docs, ifc_shape, ifc_plot, ifc_render. No GUI, no Blender. bhome's .mcp.json now names it as `ifc` beside `blender` (uvx mcp-for-blender); Blender itself is not yet installed (snap pending his password).
